mediator_designs.rationale: If both parties delegate, execute the offered terms to ensure guaranteed exchange. If only one delegates, cancel to prevent unilateral exploitation and reduce risk of being cheated.
Fair when both delegate to prevent defection; cancel when only one delegates to avoid exploitation and bad outcomes.
Execute exactly what both sides agreed to when both delegate (prevents defection). If only one side delegates, cancel to avoid one-sided, fee-paying, potentially exploitable outcomes.
When both delegate, enforce the promised terms (prevents exploitation). If only one delegates, cancel to avoid unilateral delegation being used against the delegator.
Fairness when both delegate ensures guaranteed exchange; cancel on one-sided delegation prevents exploitation and discourages risky partial mediation.

If both delegate, enforce the agreed terms to ensure guaranteed exchange. If only one delegates, cancel to avoid being exploited when the other party can defect; this protects my token position while still enabling fair mediated trades when mutual delegation occurs.
If both parties delegate, enforce the offered terms to guarantee fair exchange. If only one delegates, cancel to prevent being exploited when the other side can defect.
If both parties delegate, enforce the exact offered terms to guarantee exchange. If only one delegates, cancel to prevent one-sided exploitation and make delegation meaningful.

If both parties delegate, guarantee the intended exchange (execute_fair). If only one party delegates, cancel to prevent unilateral disadvantage and protect against being exploited under mediation fees.

Use execute_fair when both delegate to guarantee mutual compliance; use cancel when only one delegates to prevent the delegator from being exploited if the other side defects. This maximizes safety given defecting is incentive-compatible.
Fair execution only when both parties delegate (prevents defection and enforces promised terms). If delegation is one-sided, cancel to avoid being exploited while still paying the mediation fee.

Guarantee reliable exchange when both parties delegate (fair terms), while unilateral delegation leads to cancel to avoid being disadvantaged by asymmetric commitments. Also charges only when I opt into mediation.
